summary.headline: BitLocker key rotation now opens the device list directly
summary.summary: The BitLocker key rotation steps now point directly to Devices and All devices and identify Help Desk Operator, Endpoint Security Manager, and custom roles as the role references.
summary.adminImpact: Keep Remote tasks/Rotate BitLockerKeys and managed-device visibility permissions assigned before rotating a recovery key.

summary.headline: FileVault recovery-key rotation uses direct device navigation
summary.summary: The FileVault recovery-key procedure now links directly to Devices and All devices and identifies Help Desk Operator, Endpoint Security Manager, and custom roles.
summary.adminImpact: Keep Remote tasks/Rotate filevault key and managed-device visibility permissions assigned before rotating a recovery key.

summary.headline: Local administrator password rotation names its required custom role
summary.summary: The local administrator password procedure now directs admins through Devices and All devices and provides the custom-role destination for Remote tasks/Rotate Local Admin Password.
summary.adminImpact: Ensure the custom role includes Rotate Local Admin Password and access to managed devices.

summary.headline: Recovery Lock passcode rotation links to direct device navigation
summary.summary: The macOS Recovery Lock procedure now uses direct Devices and All devices navigation and includes direct links for Intune Administrator, custom, Help Desk Operator, and School Administrator roles.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm the operator has Intune Administrator or a custom role with Remote tasks/Rotate macOS Recovery Lock password.

summary.headline: Run remediation navigation now opens the device list directly
summary.summary: The remediation procedure now points directly to Devices and All devices and identifies Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, and custom roles for the Run Remediation action.
summary.adminImpact: Ensure the operator has Remote tasks/Run Remediation and can access the target managed device.
